subject: SCIENCE
title: Why Animals Matter
objective: Describe selected ecosystem roles and humane relationships.
introduction: A bee carries pollen between flowers, a worm loosens soil, and a bird carries a seed. How do animals help their ecosystems?

vocabulary.definition: A living thing that can move and needs food.
To be important or make a useful difference.
A community of living things and the place where they live and interact.

activities.instruction: Watch Milo connect animals with helpful ecosystem roles.
activities.content: Animals can pollinate, disperse seeds, improve soil, provide food products, or be companions; treat them humanely.

feedback.retry: Look for the action, then ask which plant, soil, or animal need it helps.

items.prompt: Milo watches bees, worms, and birds in a garden. Which statement about animal roles is true?

options.text: Every animal has the same role
Animals can pollinate, disperse seeds, improve soil, provide food products, or be companions.

items.explanation: Animals have different roles: bees can pollinate, worms can improve soil, and some animals spread seeds. We can learn without harming them.

items.prompt: A bee visits two flowers in Maxine's garden. What helpful job can the bee do?
items.explanation: A bee carries pollen from flower to flower, helping plants make seeds or fruit. Bees cannot make sunlight, rain, or food from stones.

items.prompt: Milo writes four claims about animals. Which one is NOT true?

options.text: Every animal has the same role

items.explanation: Animals have different jobs in their homes. Worms can improve soil, bees can pollinate, and some animals carry seeds to new places.

items.prompt: Maxine sees a bee move from one flower to another. What can the bee help do?
items.explanation: The bee moves pollen between flowers, which can help flowers make fruits and seeds. It does not make sunlight or turn stones into plants.

items.prompt: A bird carries a seed away from a parent plant. Which role does this show?

options.text: Some animals grow fur on trees
Some animals turn soil into metal

items.explanation: Carrying a seed to another place helps a plant spread, called seed dispersal. Birds do not make rain or grow fur on trees.
